subject: *: don't handle live updates of column size (#58596)
summary: Reviewed the commit relative to its parent. Change removes end-to-end “live” DML updates of column total-size (`tot_col_size`) by deleting column-size delta collection/plumbing from table DML (add/update/delete), session txn delta tracking, stats collector flush, and stats storage dumping; row-count/modify-count delta flushing remains. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session behavior, concurrency, or privilege/visibility within the scoped modules; impact is limited to stats/cost/row-size estimation accuracy as intended.
